# Test Data Attribution

- `pages.json.gz` holds Google Cloud documentation pages and discovery documents,
  recorded from `docs.cloud.google.com` and `*.googleapis.com`, with scripts, styles, and
  navigation removed. The documentation is © Google LLC and licensed under the
  [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/);
  code samples in it under the [Apache 2.0 License](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).
- `iam-dataset/` is a small excerpt in the format of
  [iam-dataset](https://github.com/iann0036/iam-dataset) by Ian Mckay, which is
  available under the MIT License.
